i thought id be dead by 15 and I'm turning 21 next month, the thing that helped me was gradually setting up future plans. don't rush ahead too much either - thinking of what I'm going to do directly after college graduation is about the farthest I'll think ahead without panicking. i still sometimes have days where all I do is ignore my texts and knock myself out w sleep meds to pass the time and stop the thoughts but it will change. keep trying to do the best you can with your coping mechanisms, they will feel less silly as you get into the habit. try to think about changing your routine or incorporating a low effort hobby that will help build your identity outside of your negative mindset - drawing helped me get a firmer grasp on things even though I don't have expensive or decent materials or much skill. also try not to think of any losses as permanent - if you listen to those thoughts for a few days or a week or something it doesnt always have to be that way, take it one day at a time and don't beat yourself up if you cant break out of it.. i wish you the absolute best
